label: GO, last ~5 trials of episode: staying on a2 after a rare-rewarded a2 trial
explanation: Sparse GO-only feature that fires only at the very end of an episode (all activations at ep_trial 90-99, value-head output in its lowest bin). It fires when the previous trial was a2 with a rare transition (to S1), and nearly all of it (97% of dev mass) needs prev_action==2 & prev_common==0. It fires mostly when that rare trial was rewarded and the agent picks a2 again, i.e. a model-free style stay rather than the model-based switch. Activation is strongest for prev_reward==1 at ep_trial >= 95, and it is mostly seen in episodes where S2 is good. Weak activations (low quartiles) also come from rare-unrewarded a2 trials and from ep_trial 90-94. It never fires at D1/D2, after a1 trials, or after common transitions. Precision is limited: many late-episode a2-rare-rewarded stays do not activate. The predicate uses only observed history, the episode position and the upcoming choice of the agent (model_act), with no future variables. On dev, a variant using choice < -6 with ep_trial >= 93 does slightly better (F1 0.61 vs 0.57); I recorded the simpler one.
